entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-21
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • SQLite: IndexOf with StringComparison is translated as startIndex #39754

Closed

  • A single non-foldable grouped aggregate forces all sibling navigation aggregates in the same projection into correlated subqueries #39628
    12.0-preview1
  • Contradicting documentation: does EF Core 11 require .NET 11 or 10? #39732
    12.0-preview1
  • Support complex properties on owned types #33170
    12.0-preview1

PullRequests

Created

  • Do not use null when padding parameter collection buckets #39756
    community-contribution
  • Fix SQLite IndexOf StringComparison overload matching #39755
    community-contribution
  • Update StyleCop.Analyzers to 1.3.180 #39753
  • Fix repeated full-text index migrations with UseLanguage #39752
  • Preserve null compensation for JSON complex properties in left joins #39751
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #39750

Merged

  • Support complex properties on owned types #39522
    community-contribution, api-review, 12.0-preview1
  • Lift GroupBy aggregates over navigations next to operator chains #39648
    community-contribution

Updated

  • Deferrable foreign keys #39443
    community-contribution
  • Merge repeated single-row subqueries into one OUTER APPLY on SQL Server #39672
    community-contribution
  • [release/10.0]: Bump StyleCop.Analyzers from 1.1.118 to 1.3.180 #39725
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/11.0] Preserve added owned references during tracking queries #39736
  • [release/11.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #39713
